# Example of Spam Chat Message

**User: TechDeals4U** (Spammer)
> Hey there! 👋 I noticed you're interested in tech products! I have AMAZING deals on the latest phones and laptops - UP TO 90% OFF!!! 🔥🔥🔥 Click this link NOW before they're gone: www.sketchy-deals-2024.xyz 💰💰💰 LIMITED TIME ONLY!!! Also, I can make you $5000 per week working from home! Interested???

**User: Sarah_M** (Recipient)
> I don't know you. Please don't send me unsolicited links.

**User: TechDeals4U** (Spammer continues)
> Wait! Don't miss out! This is a REAL opportunity! My cousin made $10K last month! Just need your email and phone number to get started! 🤑 Also check out my crypto investment program - GUARANTEED returns!!! 📈📈📈

---

**Common spam characteristics shown:**
- Excessive punctuation and emojis
- ALL CAPS for urgency
- Unsolicited links
- Too-good-to-be-true offers
- Requesting personal information
- Ignoring the recipient's response
- Multiple unrelated "opportunities" in one message
